How Walt sees 42

A two-minute sketch about playing dominoes with a handful of guesses.

0:00 / 1:00

Everything here is drawn and scored by the page itself: the pictures are plain canvas JavaScript, and the music and sound effects are synthesized in the browser. The narration was spoken by the open Kokoro text-to-speech model. 399,072,960 is the exact number of ways to deal the other 21 dominoes. "Billions of ways" to play each deal, "ten million hard drives" and "three billion dollars" (at roughly $300 a drive) are estimates: exact play-out counts for 12 random deals ranged from about 3×108 to 3×1011. Walt's tallies in the film are made up for the cartoon.
